title: Thai Penal Code RAG evaluation item
description: One JSON object per line in eval_set.jsonl. Section IDs use the same canonical form as the parser: arabic base number, optional '/n' or ordinal word, e.g. '288', '335/1', '33 ทวิ'.

question.description: user question in Thai (or the language you serve)

question_type.description: lookup=single section; multi_hop=offence+general provision; penalty=compute/state punishment; definition=บทนิยาม; exception=ยกเว้น/เหตุลดหย่อน; unanswerable=not covered by the Penal Code (tests refusal)

gold_sections.description: section(s) that DIRECTLY answer the question. Empty ONLY for question_type=unanswerable. Retrieval Recall/MRR is scored against this.

supporting_sections.description: general provisions (usually Book 1) needed to reason but not the headline answer, e.g. มาตรา 80 (attempt), 83 (ตัวการ). Used for multi_hop coverage scoring.

reference_answer.description: expert-written model answer. For 'unanswerable', the expected refusal text.

answer_claims.description: atomic factual claims in the reference answer; each is checked for grounding in gold/supporting sections (claim-level faithfulness).

applicable_version_date.description: which version of the Code applies (non-retroactivity). ISO date. Optional until you version the corpus.
